publishingInformation.testingInstructions:
This skill requires account linking to a Somfy TaHoma account.
Use the test account credentials provided in the project notes to log in at the account linking page.

After linking, say "Alexa, discover devices" or use Devices → + → Add Device in the Alexa app.
Test with "Alexa, open [device name]" or "Alexa, close [device name]".

en-US.name: Multisite TaHoma
en-US.summary: Two things the official Somfy skill can't do: control shutters across multiple TaHoma homes, and position calibration for accurate percentages.
en-US.description:
Unlike the official Somfy skill, this skill offers two capabilities that Somfy does not provide:

1. Multiple TaHoma installations — control roller shutters across all your homes from a single Alexa account. The official skill only supports one TaHoma box; this skill discovers every installation automatically and exposes all shutters as a unified device list.

2. Position calibration — Somfy motors move non-linearly. The motor may report 50% while the shutter is only 30% physically open. This skill corrects that mapping so voice commands reflect what you actually see. If your shutters need calibration tuned to your specific device, write to somfy@michalrutka.com.

Prerequisites

- One or more Somfy TaHoma Smart Home hubs (any generation supported by the Overkiz cloud platform)
- An active Somfy account with at least one paired roller shutter device
- The Alexa app on iOS or Android

Getting started

1. Enable this skill in the Alexa app and tap Link Account.
2. Enter your Somfy account email and password on the login page.
3. After linking, say "Alexa, discover devices" or use Devices → + → Add Device in the Alexa app.
4. Your roller shutters will appear named by installation and room (for example, "Home - Balcony shutter", "Spain - Balcony shutter").

Features

- Open and close roller shutters by voice: "Alexa, open the balcony shutter"
- Set a precise opening level: "Alexa, set the balcony shutter to 50 percent"
- Adjust relative to current position: "Alexa, raise the balcony shutter by 20 percent"
- Check current state: "Alexa, what is the balcony shutter set to?"
- Full support for Alexa routines and schedules
- Offline detection: Alexa reports a shutter as unreachable if it is physically disconnected

Limitations

- Only roller shutter and awning devices are supported. Other TaHoma device types (lights, heating, gates) are not exposed.
- Requires an active internet connection and access to the Somfy cloud.
- This is an unofficial, community-developed skill and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Somfy, Overkiz, or Amazon.
examplePhrases: Alexa, set the balcony shutter to fifty percent.
en-US.updatesDescription: Added position calibration — a feature not available in the official Somfy skill. Somfy motors move non-linearly: the motor may report 50% while the shutter is only 30% physically open. This update corrects that, so "set to 50 percent" moves the shutter to 50% of its real travel. If your device needs individual calibration, contact the developer at somfy@michalrutka.com.
